title: The Eureka Brass Band: first funeral and Percy Humphrey
summary: He recalls his first Eureka funeral, praises Percy Humphrey and the bass drum, and talks about Eureka personnel.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
